description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: Is this civil date a business day on the published US-FED (OPM) or GB-EAW / GB-SCT / GB-NIR (GOV.UK England and Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland) holiday calendar for 2026–2028? Raw is_business_day / weekend / holiday readings, add_n steps, and holidays_in_year lists with source_url, retrieved_at, calendar_version and attribution. Calendar arithmetic over published holiday lists; informational, as-is; not legal, tax, filing or settlement advice. Settlements are final on-chain; no refunds. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_business_day
title: Business-day calendar (US-FED / GB-EAW / GB-SCT / GB-NIR) (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
